name: forecast-protocol-v1
status: frozen before any forecasting model was fitted or scored
objective: out-of-sample predictive skill, calibration and reliability of probabilistic forecasts about real BTC prices; the simulator is one candidate feature source
domain: btc_perp: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual, 1 h bars (data/research, data/vault final split for training/retrospective only, fresh daily archives from 2026-11-01)

information_lag.rule: at origin o the model sees only bars with available_at <= o - 24 h (official daily archives are published with ~1 day delay; the live API is unreachable from this environment, HTTP 451). Target windows are (o, o + h].
information_lag.training_labels: a past origin o' is a training example at o only if o' + h <= o - 24 h (its outcome was observable)

targets.rv: realized volatility over (o, o+h]: sqrt(sum of squared hourly log returns), in %; point forecast of log RV

features: log RV over 24 h/72 h/7 d/30 d; returns over 24 h/7 d/30 d; |return| 24 h; mean high-low range 24 h; log volume ratio 24 h vs 30 d; mean funding 24 h and 7 d; all computed from bars available at o - 24 h

models.B0_climatology: binary: expanding base rate of the target over available training labels; rv: mean of past log RV
models.B1_ewma_gauss: sigma from EWMA of hourly squared returns (lambda 0.99) scaled to horizon; P(|r|>=k) = 2(1-Phi(k/sigma)); P(up) = 0.5; rv = log(sigma)
models.M1_logistic: L2 logistic regression (lambda 1.0, standardized features + log sigma_EWMA); rv: ridge regression on the same features
models.M2_gbm: gradient-boosted depth-2 regression trees on logistic loss (100 rounds, learning rate 0.05, min leaf 30); rv: same on squared loss

training: expanding window; refit every 30 origins; minimum 365 labelled origins, otherwise abstain
simulator_features: for each origin, the agent simulator (realistic-fundamental profile, world_annual_vol set from the observed 7 d RV, funding regime from observed funding) is run and summarized as: simulated/input volatility ratio, excess kurtosis, |r| ACF, liquidation count, spread; runs are cached on a quantized input grid (deterministic seeds)

periods.SCREEN: origins 2024-01-01 .. 2025-06-28 (previously exposed for strategy selection; screening only, NOT independent)
periods.CONSUMED: origins 2025-07-01 .. 2026-10-28 (consumed final split; retrospective only, NEVER fresh validation)
periods.PROSPECTIVE: forecasts written to the ledger before their target window starts; the only source of independent evidence

scoring.binary: Brier score, log loss (probabilities clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]), reliability curve (10 equal-width bins), expected calibration error, Brier skill score vs B0
scoring.rv: MSE of log RV and QLIKE
scoring.comparison: mean paired loss difference with a moving-block bootstrap 95% CI (block 10 origins, 2000 resamples, seed 0); one-sided p-value = share of bootstrap means >= 0 for 'model better'

pre_registered_comparisons.family: for each binary target (move3, move5, up) x horizon (24, 72): M1 vs B0, M1 vs B1, M2 vs B0, H1 vs M1 (24 tests) on SCREEN, Brier
pre_registered_comparisons.multiple_testing: Holm-Bonferroni at alpha 0.05 over the 24 tests
pre_registered_comparisons.rv_family: M1 vs B1 on log-RV MSE for both horizons (reported, Holm over 2)

simulator_inclusion_rule: simulator features are KEPT only if H1 beats M1 on SCREEN after Holm correction for at least one binary target AND H1 is not worse than M1 (mean Brier difference <= 0) on DEV for that target. Otherwise they are EXCLUDED from all non-experimental models and the exclusion is recorded.

rules: more than 5% of the last 30 days of bars missing
any standardized feature with |z| > 6 (out of training range)
trailing Brier skill of the model vs B0 over its last 180 resolved forecasts < 0
abstention.scoring: an abstained forecast is scored as the B0 climatology probability (fallback), so abstention cannot remove hard cases; coverage is reported

ledger: append-only, hash-chained JSONL; records: forecast (id, domain, target, horizon, model id, model version = code sha256 + protocol sha256, issued_utc, origin, as_of, inputs digest and summary, probability or point, abstained, fallback) and resolution (forecast id, outcome, resolved_utc, data source checksum). No update or delete operation exists.

evolution.candidate_space: feature subsets, L2 strength, GBM rounds/depth/learning rate, training window; no candidate can change targets, data, lag, scoring or periods
evolution.trial_accounting: every candidate evaluation is counted per target; acceptance threshold on SCREEN is a one-sided bootstrap p < 0.05 / (number of trials so far for that target) AND no Brier degradation on DEV
evolution.outcome_of_acceptance: a passing candidate becomes a CHALLENGER that is issued prospectively next to the frozen champion; it never replaces the champion automatically
evolution.promotion: requires >= 180 resolved prospective forecasts per target with a block-bootstrap CI of the Brier difference vs the champion entirely below 0, and human approval

claims_policy: retrospective results on DEV/SCREEN/CONSUMED are labelled 'retrospective, previously exposed'; no claim of predictive superiority is made without prospective evidence meeting the promotion rule

amendment_1.before: before any model was fitted or scored
amendment_1.finding: funding-rate archives are published monthly only (daily fundingRate archive: HTTP 404), so funding is unavailable at prospective issue time for up to a month
amendment_1.change: funding features are REMOVED from all models (and from simulator inputs, which use funding = 0 regime); keeping them would make retrospective information unrealistically richer than prospective information

amendment_2.after: after the first retrospective run and the first 32 prospective forecasts; prompted by a dashboard code review, not by results
corrections: the rv Holm family is restored to the registered 2 tests (M1 vs B1, 24 h and 72 h); the first report had also included the 2 H1-vs-M1 rv tests, which tightened thresholds (conclusions unchanged: both registered tests reject)

abstention rule 4 at prospective issue time now uses the model's last 180 RESOLVED prospective forecasts as registered; while fewer than 60 exist it falls back to the scored backtest series, recorded per forecast as trailing_skill_source = backtest_proxy. The first 32 forecasts used the backtest proxy without recording it.
known limitation, not changed: B0 itself is flagged 'insufficient_training' for the first ~55 DEV origins and is still scored (it is the fallback of last resort)
